title: Columbo
description:
S6 E2 — Old-Fashioned Murder
The curator (Joyce Van Patten) of a strapped family-owned museum stages a robbery, for insurance, then murders to hide her crime; guests Celeste Holm, Tim O'Connor.

title: Columbo
description:
S6 E3 — The Bye-Bye Sky-High IQ Murder Case
An accountant, embezzling to support his wife's lifestyle, murders his partner after the man discovers his crimes.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E1 — Try & Catch Me
A mystery writer uses her plot as a guide to murder her nephew, whom she blames for her niece's death.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E2 — Murder Under Glass
Columbo investigates the murder of a gourmet restaurant owner who had been the victim of an extortionist.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E3 — Make Me a Perfect Murder
A TV-network executive murders her boss and lover when he fails to promote her.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E4 — How to Dial a Murder
Columbo suspects a psychologist (Nicol Williamson), a noted expert in mind control, is guilty of murder.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E5 — The Conspirators
An Irish poet, who fronts a peace organization while secretly running guns, kills an arms dealer who tries to swindle him.

title: Columbo
description:
S8 E1 — Columbo Goes to the Guillotine
An egocentric psychic murders his old mentor, a magician charged to expose him as fraud, by beheading him while he's rehearsing his guillotine trick.

title: Columbo
description:
S8 E2 — Murder, Smoke and Shadows
A Hollywood director tries to fool Columbo when a studio becomes a murder scene.

title: Columbo
description:
S8 E3 — Sex and the Married Detective
The disheveled detective gets some free advice from a world-famous sex therapist.

title: Columbo
description:
S8 E4 — Grand Deceptions
The detective is called in to investigate the death of a sergeant major at a training camp.

title: Columbo
description:
S9 E1 — Murder, a Self Portrait
Homicide detective Lieutenant Columbo investigates the murder of a famous painter's ex-wife.

title: Columbo
description:
S9 E4 — Rest in Peace, Mrs. Columbo
When a crooked estate agent dies in prison, his widow vows to exact her revenge on the two men that put him there. After killing her husband's informing boss, she sets her sights on Lieutenant Columbo.
